title: Quark protein pancakes with berries
steps: Grind the oats finely in a blender.
Add the quark, eggs, milk and baking powder and blend to a thick batter, then rest for 5 minutes.
Brush a non-stick pan with a little oil and add 2 tbsp batter per pancake.
Cook over medium heat for 2–3 minutes per side until golden.
Serve with berries and a little maple syrup.
